audience: event organizers who sell tickets and run registrations with Tito

useCases.title: Check ticket sales per ticket type
useCases.text: The AI lists an event's releases (ticket types) with price, quantity and tickets sold, and the sold out and off sale flags. You see what is selling.

useCases.title: Review the latest registrations, orders and refunds
useCases.text: The AI lists registrations with buyer name, email, total, state and discount code, reads one in full, and lists the refunds of an event.

useCases.title: Find an attendee's ticket
useCases.text: The AI searches an event's tickets by name, email, company, reference or tag, and by state or release. It reads one ticket with the question answers.

useCases.title: Read attendees' answers to event questions
useCases.text: The AI lists the questions an event asks, such as dietary needs or t-shirt size, and the answers of every attendee. It can count or group them.

useCases.title: Check discount code use, or create and change a code
useCases.text: The AI lists discount codes with quantity used, creates a percent or money off code, or changes a code's value, quantity, validity or releases.

useCases.title: Issue a ticket by hand or fix attendee details
useCases.text: The AI issues a ticket for a release without a checkout, such as a speaker or sponsor ticket, or corrects an attendee's name, email, company, phone or tags.
